scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: A fictional message claims that the club trip has been cancelled and a refund is ready. It displays a teacher’s photo, sets a short deadline and supplies a pretend code. The destination card describes sending tokens out, contradicting the promise that tokens will be returned.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: Tara separates four questions: who is claiming authority, what action is requested, what pressure is applied and what independent checking route is available. A familiar photo does not resolve the outgoing-action mismatch. Nor does a deadline remove the need to check whether the school actually sent this request.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: Neel pauses the action and asks a trusted adult to use the existing school contact, not the new number inside the message. The team keeps time, channel and demand in its fictional record without secret values or a public accusation. The capstone combines earlier checks into one explainable response.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: Identity is unverified, the action is outgoing and a deadline pressures immediate approval. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: Identity is unverified, the action is outgoing and a deadline pressures immediate approval. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: Which response handles the whole case?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Pause, preserve minimal facts and ask an adult to check through the established school contact. This addresses identity, purpose and pressure without following the demand.
scenes.speech: Pause, preserve minimal facts and ask an adult to check through the established school contact. This addresses identity, purpose and pressure without following the demand.
scenes.dialogue: Choose an established school route rather than a contact inside the request.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate combine the clues, then choose a known route, then explain a safe response. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
